areas.title: Autonomous Systems
areas.text: Guidance, navigation and decision-making for spacecraft, rovers and swarms that operate with minimal human input.

areas.title: Satellite Engineering
areas.text: Design, analysis and operation of satellites and small-satellite missions, from individual subsystems to full mission architecture.

areas.title: Orbital Dynamics
areas.text: Trajectory design, transfers, constellations and orbit maintenance across low Earth, geostationary and lunar environments.

areas.title: Astronaut Health
areas.text: Biomedical and life-science research on how spaceflight affects the human body and how to protect future crews.

areas.title: Space Habitats
areas.text: Concepts for living and working beyond Earth, from life support and radiation protection to sustainable design.

areas.title: Earth Observation
areas.text: Using satellite data to understand our planet, from climate and land use to natural hazards and the environment.

areas.title: Emerging Space Technologies
areas.text: New ideas at the frontier of the sector, including AI for space, novel sensing and communication approaches, and next-generation systems.

methods.title: Simulation & Modeling
methods.text: Computational studies that test ideas, explore trade-offs and predict how a system behaves before anything is built.

methods.title: Experimental Analysis
methods.text: Structured experiments and data analysis that validate assumptions and measure what actually happens.

methods.title: Satellite & Mission Data
methods.text: Working with real satellite and mission datasets to ground research in real-world conditions.

methods.title: Systems Engineering
methods.text: Looking at the whole mission, from requirements and interfaces to risk, so that results hold up in practice.

methods.title: Literature-Based Investigation
methods.text: Careful review of existing research, policy and case studies to find gaps and build on what is already known.

methods.title: Interdisciplinary Collaboration
methods.text: Engineers, scientists, data specialists and policy thinkers working across fields on one shared question.
